pins.title: After a Red-Eye Flight: How to Sleep at the Hotel When It's Already Light
pins.subtitle: Mask, earplugs, and a little white noise
pins.description: Landing early often means trying to sleep in a bright, unfamiliar room with hallway and air conditioning noise. A contoured sleep mask, reusable earplugs, and a small portable white noise machine take up very little carry-on space and can make it easier to rest when you arrive. Not medical advice. #redeyeflight #travelsleep #sleepmask #carryon #traveltips

pins.title: Mini Massage Gun in Your Carry-On: What to Check Before a Long Flight
pins.subtitle: Battery rules, and why to wait until you land
pins.description: A Theragun Mini is compact enough for a carry-on, but it has a lithium-ion battery, so check TSA's What Can I Bring? tool and your airline's current battery policy first. Use it after the flight in your hotel room or a quiet layover, not in the seat, and follow the manufacturer's guidance on areas to avoid. Not medical advice. #theragunmini #massagegun #carryon #travelhacks #redeye
